Docs.param: The HTTP_REQUEST_PROPERTY identifier to query. The set of supported values is defined by the HTTP_REQUEST_PROPERTY enum in http.h; the caller is responsible for parsing the bytes returned in using the corresponding native struct.
Optional property-specific qualifier bytes. Pass an empty span for properties that do not require a qualifier; it will be mapped to a null pointer when calling the underlying API.
Destination buffer that receives the property value. Pass an empty span to query the required buffer size via .
Returns the number of bytes written to . If was too small (or empty), returns the size of the buffer required to hold the value.
Docs.summary: Reads an arbitrary HTTP_REQUEST_PROPERTY value from HTTP.SYS using the HttpQueryRequestProperty Windows API.
Docs.returns: True if the property was successfully read into . False if is not large enough to hold the value; in that case contains the required buffer size. For any other failure, an exception is thrown.
Docs.remarks: If the required buffer size is not known up front, first call this method with an empty to retrieve the required size in , then allocate that many bytes and retry the query.
Docs.exception: Any HttpSys error except for ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER or ERROR_MORE_DATA.
If the installed Windows HTTP Server API does not support HttpQueryRequestProperty.
